parsed_json.up: Select exact IC50 activities for compounds tested against human BTK (CHEMBL5251) that have a SMILES string and a PubMed ID or DOI. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, target_dictionary, docs (via assays.doc_id), and compound_structures (inner join). Filter by target CHEMBL5251, standard_type IC50, and presence of canonical_smiles and (pubmed_id or doi). Return columns compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Keep all activity rows; do not deduplicate. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
